Instructions
How to use:
  1. Enter the Ciena device IP address
  2. Provide SSH credentials (username/password)
  3. Set the local MEP ID (default: 9)
  4. Click "Run Ciena CFM Script"
  5. Wait for the script to complete (may take 1-2 minutes)
  6. Review the results and captured outputs
Important Notes:
  • Script will run CFM delay tests for all discovered EVCs
  • Each test takes approximately 30 seconds
  • Ensure the device is accessible and credentials are correct
  • Results are logged to timestamped files in the scripts directory
